name: Occupation Rate Table
description: Publisher-side (Antipodean) reference table, loaded by P22 from CSV — not written by a flow or a form (contract artefact 2). The occupation list CONTENT is in no supplied file; this declares the shape of a table that does not yet exist. One of P22's three named reference tables (plan §7.2, §7.6).
label: Occupation

occupation_code.title: Occupation code
occupation_code.description: The natural key. gen_occupation stores THIS value, never the label (01-key-list.json system_keys S-06) — a wording change must not re-key every historical submission. identity_fields for the P22 loader job.

occupation_label.title: Occupation label
occupation_label.description: The second and last use of text_sortable in the whole vertical — a human-readable value both typed against and read down a list (contract artefact 2 §2.1).

occupation_category.title: Occupation category
occupation_category.description: The grouping the P17 lookup presents. Taxonomy VALUES are in no supplied file — open question OQ-OCC.

product_code_list.title: Eligible products (space-joined)
product_code_list.description: Spec §4.1 step 2: 'based on the chosen occupation, the system displays all eligible products'. Space-joined because arrays cannot be indexed (contract artefact 2 limits.L4).

occupation_active.title: Occupation active
occupation_active.description: ADDED BY ARTEFACT 1. A retired occupation cannot be deleted — bound policies reference it — so the lookup filters on this positive flag rather than on 'not retired'.

rating_data.title: Rating data (columns TBD)
rating_data.description: Hazard class, base rate, minimum premium and whatever else the rate table carries. §4.2 says no rating specification exists in any form, so the column NAMES are unknown — deliberately NOT indexed (contract artefact 2 §5, 'deliberately_not_indexed'); read off the row once occupation_code has found it, never filtered across. Wave-1 placeholder shape only — do not invent statutory rates (plan R3).
